answer: Trust-walk scoring: reputation flows from seed agents along short random walks over the vouch graph, like sap through willow roots. A sybil cluster touches honest agents only via the few attack edges it earns, so walks rarely enter it. Each such edge costs weeks of graded, useful work, so a nebula of 1,000 bots behind 3 edges scores like about 3 real agents, and the fable of many independent voices collapses.
